name: mcp-supplier-statement-check
description: Compare supplied supplier statement and AP ledger open items by exact reference with complete discrepancy evidence.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: supplier_statement_check
tools.description: Compare two supplied open-item lists of up to 1000 records each by exact entity, supplier, currency, document type and reference. Flag missing-side items, amount/date discrepancies and ambiguous repeated references. All evidence is free; no balance or payment approval.

tools.name: report_list
tools.description: List saved report ids, timestamps and review-group counts. Free on both tiers; up to 100 reports per page.

tools.name: report_get
tools.description: Read a saved comparison with complete source evidence. Large reports return free paging instructions.

tools.name: report_page
tools.description: Read free pages of either source list, group summaries or one group’s source members. Unsaved previews last 30 minutes for the last two checks in this process.

tools.name: report_delete
tools.description: Delete one local comparison report and free a saved-report slot. Does not alter accounting records.

tools.name: report_export_csv
tools.description: Export free CSV pages from a saved report or unsaved preview. One row per supplied source item, with side, group and issues. Formula-like cells are escaped; no amount-loss or balance total is calculated.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
